app_context: BDE/BDM Lead Cockpit - Full Width Workspace
tech_stack: Vanilla JS, CSS, Laravel 11, Blade (No framework, Custom CSS)
design_philosophy: Modern, intuitive, single-screen 'Lead Cockpit'. Move from a cramped drawer to a sprawling but structured full-width layout. Use spatial distribution (3 columns) instead of hidden tabs to reduce cognitive load and clicks.

grid_blueprint.desktop_layout: grid-template-columns: 300px minmax(500px, 1fr) 340px; grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden;
grid_blueprint.responsive_behavior: Below 1200px: collapse right rail into a bottom drawer or tabs in left rail. Below 768px: stack all columns into a single scrolling view (grid-template-columns: 1fr).

surfaces.cards: border-radius: 16px; background: var(--color-card); box-shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05); padding: 24px;

tab_consolidation_strategy.previous_state: 7 crowded tabs in a narrow drawer.

mapping.Activity timeline + add-note: Moved to Main Center Column (Bottom half). Composer pinned to the top of the timeline.
mapping.Communicate (WhatsApp, Email, Call): Integrated into the unified Composer in the Main Center Column. One rich input box, switches context based on selected sub-tab.
mapping.Qualify form: Moved to Left Rail as an editable 'Qualification Summary' card.
mapping.Journey status tracker: Moved to the top of the Main Center Column as a visual horizontal stepper.
mapping.Quote/Cost-sheet: Moved to Right Rail as a dedicated summary card with an 'Expand/Add' button.
mapping.Booking: Moved to Right Rail below Quotes.
mapping.Post-Sales: Moved to Right Rail below Booking.

header.left_cluster: Avatar (Circle), Lead Name (H1), Email & Phone links, Temperature Badge, Score Bar (0-100 gauge/bar using Lime accent).
header.right_cluster: Inline stage changer (Select dropdown styled as a pill), Journey-status pill (from 45-status catalog, distinct color from stage), Quick Actions (DNC, Invalid, Won, Lost inside an 'Actions' dropdown menu button).
header.banners: If Locked/DNC/Invalid, display a full-width banner right below the header (Background: var(--color-status-locked-dnc), Text: Red).

content: Details Card: Email, phone, alt phone, city, source, campaign, project, owner, verified tick, contact attempts. Use dense grid layout (2 columns for label/value).
Qualification Summary Card: Visual display of interest, timeline, budget, financing, decision-maker, preferred location.
Site Visits Card: Mini-list of upcoming/past visits.
left_rail.styling: Use Powder-Blue panels (var(--color-panel)) for inner sections to distinguish from the main white cards.

main_workspace.position: grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; overflow-y: auto; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 24px;
content: Journey Tracker: Horizontal stepper showing live stage/status with SLA timers.
Unified Composer: A tabbed card (Note, Email, WhatsApp, Call). High visual prominence. Contains the template picker for WhatsApp.
Activity Timeline: A vertical chronological feed. Distinct icons for different activity types. Generous padding between feed items.
Open Tasks: List of actionable items with 'Complete' checkboxes/buttons prominently displayed.

Secondary Modules Stack: Quotes, Bookings, Post-Sales. Display these as compact summary cards (e.g., '1 Active Quote: $450k'). If the user needs to act, they click to open a modal or expand the card in place.

interaction_and_motion.buttons: Transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.1s ease. Active state scales down slightly (scale: 0.98).
interaction_and_motion.timeline_feed: New items should slide down and fade in (opacity 0 to 1, translateY -10px to 0).
interaction_and_motion.hover_states: All clickable rows (Tasks, Site visits) must have a hover state (e.g., background shifts slightly darker off-white) to indicate interactivity.

accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a visible focus ring (2px solid var(--color-ink) with offset).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure var(--color-ink-muted) meets 4.5:1 contrast ratio against var(--color-page).
accessibility.aria: Use aria-expanded for the unified composer tabs and accordions in the right rail.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: CRITICAL: Do NOT use Shadcn or React. Output only pure HTML/Blade structures, CSS variables, and Vanilla JS layout scripts.

CRITICAL: EVERY interactive element, button, tab, and form input MUST retain or include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='lead-header-name', data-testid='tab-whatsapp'). Do not strip existing test IDs.
Use CSS Grid for the macro layout. Avoid absolute positioning for core layout columns.
Maximize the use of whitespace. The layout is full width, so do not cramp inner padding; use 24px or 32px padding inside cards.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds in dropdowns or sticky headers. Ensure backdrop-filters or solid colors are applied.
Apply the lime accent selectively. It should draw the eye to primary CTAs (e.g., 'Log Activity', 'Mark Won', Score Bar), not be splashed everywhere.
Make the Right Rail modules look like 'Widgets' — they summarize data but afford deep-dives via clicks.
Implement scroll shadows or sticky headers for the Left and Right rails so the center column scrolls independently.
